By employing a hybrid model combining CNN and LSTM techniques, the research delves into the complex connections present in stock price time series data. The suggested model combines CNN methods to efficiently gather features from the data of the past 10 days, along with the LSTM algorithm to understand temporal changes. Comparative assessments indicate that the CNN-LSTM technique performs better than conventional models like MLP, CNN, RNN, LSTM., and CNN-RNN in predicting stock prices in terms of reliability and accuracy. The research provides important findings for predicting future stock prices and offers a useful tool for academics and investors who are working with financial data over time. The use of Python-based TensorFlow to implement the CNN-LSTM model shows promise in uncovering valuable patterns in past stock data. The outcomes indicate its efficiency using criteria such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), demonstrating better results than older and newer models. The study advances the conversation about incorporating sophisticated deep learning methods in financial analysis, laying the groundwork for more investigation and improvement of predictive models in the ever-changing financial markets.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Energy Management: IoT and Blockchain Integration for Sustainable Buildings - An Alternative Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Research in buildings' energy management continues to thrive, driven by the escalating demand for energy alongside technological advancements. This necessitates innovative approaches for effective mitigation. This study focuses on AI-based demand-side management and proposes a blockchain-enabled payment gateway as a smart solution. The initial investigation building energy generation and utilization using historical data from smart meters. The Thiagarajar College of Engineering, located in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, serves as the test system with 60 smart meters installed across the campus's main block. Data collected from these meters is analyzed using AI tools to categorize and control energy demand. Incorporating DSM strategies and renewable sources leads to reduced electricity tariffs. To ensure secure e-transactions, Etherscan solidity, and Metamask wallets are utilized for smart contract development. Metamask establishes the gateway, while Etherscan retrieves transaction history via highly secured recovery phrases. Although blockchain-enabled transactions offer significant advantages, their usage remains limited. The study anticipates broader adoption in the future.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence for Energy Audit in Industry to Improve the Performance and Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: In manufacturing industries, effective energy management is crucial for lowering production costs and maintaining market competitiveness. Typically, this management is achieved through energy audits, with electrical energy audits specifically targeting the identification and analysis of electrical losses during manufacturing. Through energy audits, this study explores the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in industrial settings to enhance operational performance and energy efficiency. Traditional energy audit methods, while effective, often face limitations in scalability and real-time analysis. By utilizing machine learning algorithms, predictive modeling, and advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI) presents a viable substitute that can yield more profound understanding of energy consumption trends. This research examines various AI-driven techniques and tools that facilitate the identification of inefficiencies, predict energy usage trends, and recommend actionable improvements. Through case studies and empirical data, the paper demonstrates how AIbased audits can optimize energy management practices, reduce operational costs, and contribute to sustainability goals. The findings suggest that integrating AI into energy audits can significantly transform industrial energy practices by providing more accurate, timely, and actionable data.

Author Keywords: Energy Efficiency Energy Audit Artificial Intelligence

articleTitle: XAI Based Machine Learning approach for Bean Crop Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Bean crops are vulnerable to numerous diseases such as anthracnose, bacterial blights, common bean mosaic, rust, etc. which can greatly affect their yield and quality. This research paper explores the diagnosis of bean crop diseases using machine learning algorithms by leveraging two feature extraction methods, namely Local Binary Pattern (LBP) and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). These techniques were applied to extract significant features followed by simulating with various ML models for disease detection such as SVM, KNN etc. Additionally, Explainable AI (XAI) methodologies have been integrated into the dataset, providing transparency and interpretability to the performance of the machine learning models. Out of several ML models used, Random Forest performed the best with an accuracy of 0.81. Effect of various color spaces on the classification process have also been explored in this work and it was found that the model performed best in Greyscale color space. Here, the extracted features have been transformed into 1D feature vectors which makes the process computationally less expensive and as grayscale is a 2D color space, it adds more to the efficiency.

articleTitle: Designing An Internet of Things Smart Device to Track Atmospheric Pollution Both Indoors and Outdoors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Air pollution, a growing concern in both indoor and outdoor environments, is driven by chemical, physical, and biological factors that disrupt the natural balance of the atmosphere. The study addresses the critical issue of air pollution, which arises from chemical, physical, or biological factors altering the atmosphere's composition, affecting both indoor and outdoor environments. In response to rapid industrialization, the research proposes a comprehensive system to monitor air quality using an IoT-based Arduino device. This system integrates sensors to measure air pollutants such as CO2, NOx, and PM2.5, alongside temperature and humidity levels. The data is securely transmitted to the IoT cloud via Blues Wireless Notehub's Wi-Fi module, allowing real-time Air Quality Index (AQI) analysis. Additionally, an indoor fire detector enhances safety by measuring indoor pollution levels and sounding alarms during fires. The proposed model offers a reliable, low-power solution for continuous air quality monitoring, making it a valuable tool for ensuring environmental safety.

articleTitle: Hyper Spectral Satellite Image Classification Based Land And Water Bodies Area Detection Using Machine Learning And Opencv Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Remote sensing is one of the important applications for monitoring the ecological conditions in the world. Over the years of climate change and urbanization produced a greater impact on land utilization as compared to its original form. With the help of satellite images like LIDAR, Senitel and Hyperspectral images, the remote sensing process were performed. Among these images, the Hyper-Spectral image have a greater advantage and impact in analyzing the land utilization. Because this HS images has both spectral and spatial properties of the region and it helps to improve the land classification. Several research works also stated that both spatial and spectral properties of HS image is required for analysis and these features were collected using multi-models or individual network. Hence, in this, the land classification using HS images were performed using Attention based modified VGN network. To perform this, the images undergo two main processes namely channel transformation from RGB to LAB and LBP image formation for an efficient feature extraction and classification in A-M-VGN. This proposed method was tested on multi-class like agricultural, barren, green and water bodies region in HS images and evaluated using Accuracy, computation time, Kurtosis, Standard Deviation and mean. The Kurtosis, mean and SD helps to analyze the pixel variations in the image. The results showed that the proposed approach is efficient for land classification using HS images.

articleTitle: Optimized Standalone Hybrid Microgrid Design for Reliable Electrification in Remote Rural Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: A standalone micro-grid is crucial for electrifying remote rural areas without grid access. To ensure reliable power, frequency and voltage must stay within specified limits. Renewable sources increase intermittency and reduce system inertia, causing stability issues. A proposed hybrid micro-grid features wind and solar renewable sources, fuel cell and diesel generator backups, AC and 48V DC loads, and battery and super-capacitor storage. A three-phase inverter links the DC bus to the AC side. The goal is to design a 16.5kW hybrid micro-grid for rural communities, including a 48V DC lighting system. The system is simulated in MATLAB SIMULINK for scenarios with and without renewable sources, considering daytime and nighttime conditions. Generation must meet demand, maintaining nominal DC voltage, with graphical analysis provided. Thus, a 16.5kW hybrid micro-grid with a 48V DC lighting system with fuel cell backup is designed and simulated.

articleTitle: Discriminating Flash Events From DDoS Attacks Using Cross-Channel Attentional Deep Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Distributed denials of service (DDoS) attacks are the core attacks in the cyber world, where the attackers intentionally transmit more attack packets to the normal traffic to disrupt system services. Flash events on the other hand represent an unexpected surge, in which the traffic is quite different from illegitimate traffic. Discriminating flash events from DDoS is an important task to identify legitimate traffic from illegitimate traffic, but remains challenging due to certain difficulties in detection and generates maximum false alerts in flash events. To address these issues, this research proposed a deep recurrent neural network with a hybrid efficient cross-channel attention module (EC-deep RNN) to effectively discriminate flash events from DDoS. This model is ensemble with a hybrid efficient cross-channel attention module, which is the combination of two channel-based attention techniques, namely efficient channel attention as well as cross-channel attention that boost the model’s progress for better performance. The EC-deep RNN model provides significant results and also eliminates existing limitations including over-fitting issues, poor solutions, and complications of using large datasets. Moreover, the model achieves 95.50% accuracy, 95.94% precision, 95.83% of recall, and 95.89% of F1-score compared to other methods.

articleTitle: India’s Current Scenario and Challenges of Ultra-Fast Charging Stations with Renewable Energy Integration and Energy Storage Systems: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: The widespread adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) necessitates an increased number of ultra-fast chargers to minimize latency for EV charging. This requirement leads to a significant demand for electricity within a short period, which may have negative effects on power quality, such as voltage sag, harmonics, grid instability, and increased base load profiles. In the face of mounting global warming concerns, the use of renewable energy resources like solar photovoltaic (PV), concentrated solar power (CSP), Hydrogen and wind energy is crucial. The distribution generation network holds advantages over conventional electrical generation, especially when it comes to fulfilling the massive energy requirements. It can play a vital role in the carbon reduction revolution.However, due to the intermittent nature of renewable energy resources, the integration of fuel cell and energy storage systems is necessary to ensure smooth operation. The advanced power electronic converters are essential for battery energy storage, renewable energy and power quality improvement. This paper presents a state-of-the-art review on the integration of ultra-fast charging stations with renewable energy sources and battery energy storage for charging EVs. Additionally, it demonstrated 80kW DC fast charging using MATLAB Simulink in this paper.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient for Multi-Agent Robotics in Virtual Simulations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: In this research, robots act as multi-agents for pathplanning techniques in unpredictable environments. By using the reinforcement learning method, the target point can be reached most efficiently from the starting point. This paper first introduces the Q-learning algorithm and deep Q-networks, which are implemented to improve the Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (IMADDPG). A new algorithm, namely IMADDPG, is proposed in this work based on the deep deterministic policy gradient, utilizing the centralized critic and actor decentralized (CCAD) framework. The benefits and drawbacks of guiding the robot with IMADDPG reinforcement learning techniques are discussed under both static and dynamic obstacle conditions. By employing a reinforcement learning technique, the robot can make intelligent decisions, adapt to changes in its surroundings, and learn from its experiences. To determine the potential of this method for practical applications, the effectiveness and performance of the proposed algorithm are analyzed. The ultimate goal of this work is to create a reliable and efficient robot navigation system capable of navigating effectively in unknown environments. The simulation results of the proposed algorithm are compared with MADDPG, DDPG, D3PG, and DQN, using training episodes up to 2000. The findings reveal a success rate of 96% and a failure rate of 1.2%.

Author Keywords: Q learning and Deep Q network

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-driven Solution for Prompt Identification of Mental Health Concerns in Adolescents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Globally, adolescents’ mental health is a major problem, and successful intervention and therapy depend heavily on early identification. In this research, we present the creation of an AI-based system to identify mental health problems in teenagers at an early age. In order to find possible symptoms of mental health issues, the system uses machine learning algorithms to examine data from a variety of sources, such as social media postings, text messages, and behavioral patterns. In order to extract mood, linguistic patterns, and semantic clues suggestive of psychological discomfort, the system incorporates natural language processing techniques. It also uses information from wearable technology and smartphone apps to track activity levels and physiological signs, giving parents a complete picture of their adolescent’s health. Feature extraction, sentiment analysis, anomaly detection, and risk assessment algorithms are important parts of the AI system that work together to identify early warning indicators of mental health problems. To increase accuracy and generalization across various demographic groups and cultural situations, the system makes use of cutting-edge neural network designs that have been trained on a variety of datasets. Throughout the system development and deployment phases, ethical issues such as data protection, confidentiality, and informed permission are carefully taken into account. Integration of the AI system with the current healthcare infrastructure enables smooth communication between mental health specialists, caregivers, and the AI system, facilitating prompt interventions and support services.

articleTitle: Automated Medical Record Summarization for Diagnosis and Training Doctors Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: This paper investigates the potential of computers and artificial intelligence (AI) to fundamentally alter the landscape of the healthcare industry. It emphasizes how computers can refine the accuracy of diagnosing diseases by processing medical records and leveraging AI-based tools. The paper also sheds light on the profound impact that analyzing electronic health records (EHRs) can have on enhancing healthcare delivery and empowering patients. It also considers the use of internet search data as an innovative approach for the early detection of diseases, while also addressing the concern that access to health information online could lead to excessive worry among patients. The paper discusses advanced methodologies such as neural networks and deep learning and acknowledges the challenges they present, including the danger of overfitting and the necessity for effective data visualization. It also considers the revolutionary potential of EHRs in redefining healthcare delivery and in giving patients more control over their health. In addition, the paper looks at the significant changes that the adoption of electronic health records (EHRs) can bring to healthcare delivery and patient empowerment.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of an Energy-Efficient Single-Phase Capacitor Run Induction Motor for Washing Machine Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Nowadays single-phase induction motors (SPIMs) are widely used in domestic to industrial appliances. As a result, SPIMs have high demand in today's market. SPIMs are responsible for driving the rotating drum of the washing machine. In recent years, there has been a trend towards the use of more energy-efficient SPIMs in washing machines. This is due to the growing awareness of energy conservation. The manufacturers are using 175 to 750 watts, four pole motors in their products due to their high efficiency. So, to increase the efficiency and reduce the cost & size further, two motors with steel-1010 core material are proposed one with four poles and the other with two poles with a capacity of 250 watts. The parameters of the motors are calculated and analyzed in MATLAB and Ansys workbench respectively. The results obtained by the two-pole motor are better than others by reducing the losses by 3% and increasing the efficiency by 2.7%.

articleTitle: AI Tools for Enhanced English Learning: Leveraging Machine Learning for Improved Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: First, AI has implemented English language learning by providing a tailor-made approach to education. Yet, the current methods based on AI have certain drawbacks, including exclusive reliance on such static characteristics of a learner as study routine, rigid flexibility, and poor interpretation of the context in which the speech is delivered’, which may lead to speech suppression; unaddressed individual learning requirements – low learning attainment and engagement; This paper outlines a new approach to English as a foreign language based on the application of AI and advanced ML methods such as NLP and adaptive The proposed system can also support flexible learning and Delivery mode that engages learners with their own skills, writing and speaking feedback, and participation with on gamified learning experience. Further, the rationale for the middle section focuses on the utilization of real-time speech recognition to enhance word pronunciation of students besides employing text-recognition technologies enhanced by artificial intelligence to augment learning activities. The general approach of the overall methodology comprises of NLP based context comprehension, along with the process of gamification, and the coming together of flexibility of curriculum and simulation of actual practice. Algorithms collected data to employ it for the customization of the learning interactions and improving the structure of the platform throughout learners’ engagement. In addition to overcoming the existing shortcomings, the present approach suggests elements that can promote the most suitable and effective method of teaching English to diverse groups of learners.

articleTitle: Optimizing Climate Impact Assessment: Sloth-Inspired Optimization with Ridge Regression for Socio-economic Policy Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Global socio-economic systems are facing serious problems as a result of climate change, making it necessary for the development of reliable approaches for evaluating its effects and guiding policy decisions. When processing complicated climatic and financial statistics, traditional strategies often have accuracy and interpretability problems. The goal of this research is to optimize the evaluation of climate impact with the aid of integrating the Sloth-inspired Optimization algorithm (SIOA) with Ridge Regression (RR). This technique provides a novel framework for optimizing selecting features and enhancing the reliability of predictions in socio-economic modelling. This integration seeks to address the shortcomings of traditional strategies by using enhancing model interpretability and performance in weather effect assessment. The financial outcomes of weather alternate are then expected by way of integrating a subset of characteristics right into a Ridge Regression version, with an emphasis on growing model interpretability and decreasing prediction mistakes. A climate observe dataset employed to the included architecture produced effective outcomes. Ridge Regression's prediction accuracy become stepped forward, and metrics for mean Squared error (MSE) and mean Absolute errors (MAE) were reduced, owing to SIOA's a success identification of vital weather variability. The potential to capture elaborate linkages amongst climatic factors and economic repercussions became shown to be superior when compared to traditional techniques of study. This paradigm is beneficial for making plans sustainable development and making knowledgeable decisions because it now not most effective increases prediction abilities but also fosters a higher expertise of the dynamic interplay between climatic factors and financial outcomes.

articleTitle: Comparing Machine Learning Approaches for Predicting the Severity of Alzheimer Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) necessitates the development of accurate predictive models to determine the severity of this neurodegenerative disorder. This paper provides a comparative analysis of various machine learning (ML) approaches, including traditional algorithms and hybrid models, for predicting the severity of Alzheimer’s disease. The study employs multiple datasets and incorporates feature selection techniques to enhance model performance. We explore and benchmark several ML algorithms such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM), alongside hybrid models. Our results demonstrate that hybrid models significantly outperform traditional ML approaches in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Moreover, we discuss the implications of these findings for clinical practice and future research directions. This comprehensive analysis underscores the potential of hybrid ML models in the early diagnosis and management of Alzheimer’s disease, ultimately contributing to improved patient outcomes. Future work will focus on integrating longitudinal data and exploring advanced neural network architectures to further refine predictive capabilities.

articleTitle: Design the Solar and Wind Hybrid EV Charging Station For Various Specific Sites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: Growing reliance on fossil fuels such as coal, oil, and diesel are resulted in serious environmental catastrophes in this modern era. These resources are becoming scarce as a result of their inversely declining supply and ongoing exponential growth in demand. Therefore, the installation of more charging stations for electric vehicles is crucial in order to resolve this problem and reduce energy billing and traffic. According to the research, five specific areas including Madurai, Virudhunagar, Tirunelveli, Sattur, and Kayathar in Tamil Nadu, where design a real-time hybrid electric vehicle charging stations (HEVCS) that are mostly powered by solar and wind energy. When the charging station system is linked to the on-grid solar-wind network, the plan includes a cost and environmental analysis of the complete system. Additionally, the analysis is conducted using HOMER software, and the performance of the charging station is evaluated in detail.

articleTitle: Analyzing Customer Preferences in the Food Delivery Industry Using Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 1st International Conference on Green Industrial Electronics and Sustainable Technologies (GIEST)
abstract: This research explores the food delivery industry’s digital transformation and its potential through big data analytics. The attributes under scrutiny include restaurant identification, geographical metadata, city-based information, restaurant nomenclature, pricing data, customer ratings, total review counts, cuisine categorizations, physical location data, and delivery duration statistics. The research outcomes bear substantial relevance to data-driven decision- making for restaurateurs, digital food delivery platforms, and policymakers, providing actionable insights for operational enhancements and informed strategies. Additionally, these findings elucidate dynamic industry trends, offering a foundational framework for further computational research in this rapidly evolving domain thorough investigation of consumer preferences and the elements that go into a satisfying dining experience is made possible by the addition of customer ratings, the total number of reviews, and cuisine classifications. The research expands its focus to consider the time-related aspects by exploring how industry patterns change over time. The outcomes of this study are highly relevant for making informed, data-driven decisions in the food delivery industry. These insights can guide policymakers, digital food delivery companies, and restaurant owners in crafting effective strategies and enhancing their operations.
